testcase.description: BIR51 FS — Full HKFRS, Consolidated Accounts

variation.name: bir51_fs_hkfrs_consolidated
variation.description: A valid financial statements iXBRL data file for a BIR51 (corporation) filing where accounts are prepared at consolidated level (AccountsPreparedAtConsolidatedLevel = true in the TC file). Revenue and ProfitLossBeforeTax are not mandatory in this path. TotalEquity remains mandatory. The FS file is trimmed to entity-level statement of financial position and other relevant entity-level information.
